title: Hospital Laboratory Excellence Program: Rethinking Partnership and Performance in Evolving Health Systems
body_markdown:
Health systems spend enormous time discussing capacity, quality, workforce, and financial performance, yet one of the most influential drivers of each often goes overlooked: the laboratory.


Through each conversation, significant attention centers on clinical operations, care delivery models, and strategic growth initiatives. Yet lab testing and results influence nearly every


patient


journey, supporting clinical decision-making, informing treatment plans, and helping organizations deliver safe, effective care.


For many organizations, the laboratory has traditionally been viewed through


an operational


lens, measured by turnaround times, staffing, quality metrics, and cost management. Those remain important indicators of performance,


but in


today's healthcare environment are no longer enough on their own.


The future of laboratory excellence is not simply about running a better laboratory. It's about leveraging the laboratory to support the health system's strategic, clinical, and operational goals.


With more than 4,000 partnerships and over 200 managed labs over decades of experience, we know that when lab strategy is aligned with enterprise priorities, the impact extends far beyond the walls of the lab. A high-performing lab can help improve operational efficiency, support quality initiatives, strengthen financial performance, enhance


the patient


experience, and create greater consistency across a health system.


The challenge for many health systems is fully understanding lab performance, how it compares to leading organizations, and identifying the greatest opportunities to create value across the enterprise.


**That's why we developed the Hospital Lab Excellence Program.**


[Our Hospital Lab Excellence Program](https://www.labcorp.com/organizations/capabilities/lab-programs-partnerships) is designed to help systems evaluate laboratory performance through both


an operational


and strategic


lens


. This program combines performance insights with access to one of the industry’s largest communities of hospital laboratories, creating opportunities to learn from proven practices, comparing


performance


and accelerating improvement.


Through a tiered, scalable framework tailored to system goals, it brings hospitals into a broader community focused on advancing laboratory excellence. Through shared insights, proven practices, and access to a network of expertise, organizations can learn from the experiences of others while gaining a clearer understanding of their own opportunities for growth.


> More importantly, it helps answer a fundamental question: **How can the laboratory contribute more meaningfully to the success of the health system?**


Whether the focus is improving operational efficiency, addressing workforce pressures, enhancing financial performance, reducing variation across sites, or supporting long-term growth strategies, the program provides a structured approach to understanding where opportunities exist and how to prioritize them.


## A “Better Together” mindset for patient care and system goals


The heart of the program is the belief that improvement happens faster when organizations learn from shared experience.


Healthcare leaders consistently seek opportunities to adopt proven practices and benefit from the insights of peers facing similar challenges. Laboratories should be no different. While every health system's journey is unique, they face many shared challenges, from workforce shortages and operational complexity to quality improvement and financial pressures.


Through access to broader expertise, integrated data with performance insights, and a community committed to advancing laboratory excellence, our collaborative approach helps health systems move beyond isolated problem-solving and accelerate progress through collective knowledge and shared learning. Connecting visibility to performance, actionable insights, and practical strategies can support both lab objectives and enterprise goals.


By helping lab leaders better understand their current state and identify achievable opportunities for improvement, Labcorp's Hospital Lab Excellence Program creates a foundation for informed decision-making and continuous progress. Our core belief: Data becomes insight. Insight drives action. Action creates


impact


.


Laboratory partnerships will play an increasingly important role in helping organizations navigate complexity, support clinicians, improve patient outcomes, and achieve financial sustainability. Organizations that can realize the greatest value will view the laboratory not simply as a department, but as a strategic partner in achieving system-wide objectives.


We created the Hospital Lab Excellence Program with that vision in mind. By combining performance assessment, actionable insights, and access to broader expertise, we help health systems better understand where they are today and identify opportunities for where they can go next.
